command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== bedtools: exact set algebra on constructed intervals (algorithmic, no band) =="
# Inline BED. A is sorted by start; B likewise. Every asserted integer below is
# hand-derived in the README, which is what makes this exact-or-wrong, not a band.
printf 'chr1\t0\t100\nchr1\t50\t150\nchr1\t200\t300\n' > a.bed
printf 'chr1\t75\t125\nchr1\t250\t350\n' > b.bed
printf 'chr1\t400\n' > genome.txt

bedtools merge     -i a.bed          > merge.bed
bedtools intersect -a a.bed -b b.bed > intersect.bed
bedtools subtract  -a a.bed -b b.bed > subtract.bed
bedtools genomecov -i a.bed -g genome.txt > genomecov.txt

bp(){ awk '{s+=$3-$2}END{print s+0}' "$1"; }
MI=$(wc -l < merge.bed | tr -d ' ');     MB=$(bp merge.bed)
II=$(wc -l < intersect.bed | tr -d ' '); IB=$(bp intersect.bed)
SI=$(wc -l < subtract.bed | tr -d ' ');  SB=$(bp subtract.bed)
D0=$(awk '$1=="chr1"&&$2==0{print $3}' genomecov.txt)
D1=$(awk '$1=="chr1"&&$2==1{print $3}' genomecov.txt)
D2=$(awk '$1=="chr1"&&$2==2{print $3}' genomecov.txt)
GS=$(awk '$1=="chr1"{s+=$3}END{print s}' genomecov.txt)

{
  echo "merge_intervals      $MI   want 2     ([0,100]u[50,150] -> [0,150]; [200,300])"
  echo "merge_bp             $MB   want 250   (150 + 100)"
  echo "intersect_intervals  $II   want 3     ([75,100],[75,125],[250,300])"
  echo "intersect_bp         $IB   want 125   (25 + 50 + 50)"
  echo "subtract_intervals   $SI   want 4     ([0,75],[50,75],[125,150],[200,250])"
  echo "subtract_bp          $SB   want 175   (75 + 25 + 25 + 50)"
  echo "genomecov_depth0     $D0   want 150   ([150,200)+[300,400))"
  echo "genomecov_depth1     $D1   want 200   ([0,50)+[100,150)+[200,300))"
  echo "genomecov_depth2     $D2   want 50    ([50,100))"
  echo "genomecov_sum        $GS   want 400   == genome length (conservation)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$MI" -eq 2;   test "$MB" -eq 250
test "$II" -eq 3;   test "$IB" -eq 125
test "$SI" -eq 4;   test "$SB" -eq 175
test "$D0" -eq 150; test "$D1" -eq 200; test "$D2" -eq 50
test "$GS" -eq 400
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
